verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside the Statsig console that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server and ChatGPT integration bring Statsig into external AI tools, which is a different capability. Autotune AI is an automated bandit optimizer, not an assistant that takes delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
